verdict.rationale: Natural-language operation is a fair question for a terminal app, since terminals can ship AI or natural-language command layers. The evidence shows a-Shell accepts only Unix-style shell commands. The nearby features don't count: Apple Shortcuts runs literal command lists, and VoiceOver only reads typed commands and output aloud, so neither interprets natural language.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
